notes: Cosmological/astrophysical constraint (not a haloscope) recasting DM-decay searches (X-ray, CMB, CRB, BBN) onto the irreducible freeze-in axion abundance. Paper constrains BOTH a photophilic axion (g_agamma vs m_a, Fig.1 = AxionPhoton) and a photophobic axion (g_aee vs m_a, Fig.2 = AxionElectron); I extracted the AxionPhoton case per hint. Only one explicit numerical value quoted in text: at m_a=10 keV, g_agamma <= 8.1e-14 GeV^-1. The full exclusion region spans roughly 100 eV to 100 MeV in the g_agamma-m_a plane but detailed contour values are only available in Fig.1 (not tabulated). For the photophobic case, at 100 keV g_aee <= 8.0e-15. No local DM density used since this is not a DM-detection haloscope.
